latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Editor AI Simple — fast, cloud-based video editing with AI.

- Upload raw video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) and receive 1080p MP4 edits in 30–60 seconds.
- Describe desired edits in plain language; no manual timeline work required.
- Handles footage upload, session setup, and editing pipeline automatically via cloud backend.
- Built for casual creators and beginners; simple credits system with 100 free credits on signup.
- Supports quick trimming, adding transitions, overlays, and exporting clean final cuts.
- Comprehensive error handling and clear instruction mapping for a smooth user experience.
